title: Dedicated Carrier Pricing for Short-Notice Exchange Replacement Deliveries — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Handover lead time.** For an exchange replacement order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, the handover lead time is the number of calendar days from the replacement order's signing date to the date of the handover appointment currently scheduled for it. The appointment date is the scheduled date shown on the order's Delivery & Pickup Appointments record.

**Pricing rule.** A short handover lead time needs a dedicated carrier and changes how the exchange transport price is set. The distance used is the exchange pricing distance, the distance on which the exchange replacement is priced.

| Handover lead time | Exchange transport price |
|---|---|
| 2 days or fewer (the rush lead days) | the exchange pricing distance times $1.45 per mile (the rush per-mile rate), rounded half up to the cent, with no band fee |
| more than 2 days, up to 5 days (the priority lead days) | the higher of the band fee of the band the exchange pricing distance falls in and the exchange pricing distance times $1.15 per mile (the priority per-mile rate), the per-mile product rounded half up to the cent |
| more than 5 days | the band fee of the band the exchange pricing distance falls in |

The transport price set under this rule is the price to which the discount percentage of the exchange replacement shipping fee is applied, the discounted price being rounded half up to the cent.

**Lead time by day count.**

| Calendar days from signing to the scheduled appointment | Pricing |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | rush per-mile rate |
| 3, 4 or 5 | higher of band fee and priority per-mile price |
| 6 or more | band fee |

**Worked examples (hypothetical, exchange pricing distance 600 miles, second band fee $799.00).**
- Signed on day 0, appointment on day 2: 600 times $1.45 is $870.00.
- Appointment on day 3: 600 times $1.15 is $690.00; the higher of $799.00 and $690.00 is $799.00.
- Appointment on day 6: $799.00, the band fee.

**Worked example (hypothetical, exchange pricing distance 800 miles, appointment on day 5).** 800 times $1.15 is $920.00, higher than the $799.00 band fee, so the transport price is $920.00.

**Rescheduled appointments.** The lead time is measured to the appointment currently scheduled; when the appointment is moved, the lead time is read from the new scheduled date.
